title: Brain shown to secrete DMT endogenously, Michigan research

tellings.quote: for example well we now know the brain we thought that the brain couldn't produce it it was produced in the lungs now we know that the brain can endogen endogenously secrete the Mt and DMT receptors are all over the brain chemo Mortgage in at Michigan

plain: The writer Graham Hancock says research at the University of Michigan has shown that the brain itself can make DMT, a powerful psychedelic compound, which scientists once thought came from the lungs, and that DMT receptors are found all over the brain. He credits this work to a researcher there named Jimo Borjigin. It matters to him because it would suggest the visionary experiences DMT produces are built into the brain.
